claims.quote: STXBP1 haploinsufficiency, a major genetic cause of developmental and epileptic encephalopathies, exhibits variability in clinical severity and remains poorly understood mechanistically.
STXBP1 haploinsufficiency, a major genetic cause of developmental and epileptic encephalopathies, exhibits variability in clinical severity and remains poorly understood mechanistically.

Although STXBP1 encodes a core presynaptic protein essential for SNARE-mediated neurotransmitter release, evidence from rodent models and patient-derived neurons indicates that its deficiency produces far broader molecular and cellular disruptions across multiple neurodevelopmental processes.
